subject: storytime
title: Click Clack Moo words
about: The cows on Farmer Brown's farm find an old typewriter and start leaving him notes, and soon the hens and the ducks have ideas of their own. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the animal words.

book.author: Doreen Cronin
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A barnyard of animals who learn to type and find out just how much one little note can do.

passage.text:
cows farm barn farmer
moo hens eggs ducks
pond milk click type
note clack cold blankets
want please

cards.note: ow says ou as in out, like in cow; the s says z
two parts: farm + er; ar says ar, er says er
oo says long oo, like moon
gg is one sound; the s says z
ck is one sound; the s says s
c-l blend; ck is one sound
y says long i here, like in my, and the e is magic e: tipe
magic e: the e makes o say its name
c-l blend; ck is one sound
the o says its name, like in old
b-l blend; n says ng before k; two parts: blan + kets
a says o as in hot: wont
ea says long e, se says z: pleez
